points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable f6d8a183 CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench container (2 CPUs, 3 GiB) with external dependencies; no solver rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:21–37 accepts case/output but has no required --restart option. Invalid-input execution not rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated mesh, partition, solver, implicit, transient, output modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal executable-wrapper evidence was found; trust policy prohibits external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case parsing and CGNS mesh path input; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halo exist, but solver.cpp:12–20 and solver.hpp:57 retain complete mesh per rank throughout solving, violating TASK full-mesh prohibition; rank-0 VTU/restart hold only its local data.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Divergent and nonphysical viscous cases show poor robustness.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Original validation reported six structural passes and two fails, but surviving steady histories expose additional false-success labels; no numerical rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Reasonably modular source; helper has absolute legacy paths.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
